SYC.note: The BTI is an incubator; no startup law, strategy or public startup fund is stated.

facts.fact: SeyCCAT announces the launch of the Business, Technology & Innovation Incubator (BTI), supported by NISTI, GEF7, SeyCCAT and GFCR, offering up to 12 months of incubation, mentoring and seed-funding access, with applications open for the 2026 cohort.
